source_level_compatibility: REA documented ELF MIPS admission excludes MIPS-II/III. Goemon actual ELF e_flags not inspected. Raw MIPS ROM admission not documented.

pilot_tasks.title: Admission and true ELF header
procedure: Verify pinned upstream and original ROM identity locally.
Run readelf -hW on actual build ELF and record MIPS e_flags, type, class and ABI records.
Run decomp.rea_pilot_preflight --strict; treat known MIPS-II/III as refusal.
Only on potentially eligible header, start local pinned REA/Ghidra and capture explicit admission/refusal and language.
pilot_tasks.acceptance: REA official target admits unmodified ELF; else produce explicit compatibility refusal without trying to bypass support.

pilot_tasks.title: Ten verified-function controls
procedure: Cross-check control list against live manifest.
Extract provider function and instruction evidence for each exact original VMA.
Independently verify address/size and known call/reference/field semantics.
Record all ten scores and any contradictory pseudocode.
pilot_tasks.acceptance: 10/10 exact addresses and extents, >=6 substantive independently supported xref or field facts, no invented ABI.

pilot_tasks.title: 196-byte VM lookup experiment
prerequisites: private original VM code and pinned IDO
procedure: Record baseline 196-byte candidate's current 25/42 instruction match and first differences.
Use only admitted REA function/caller/reference evidence to form one typed source hypothesis.
Compare fresh native IDO -c at original VMA, run existing synthetic tests.
If better, retain as research; no promotion without G2 full-ROM verification.
pilot_tasks.acceptance: At least one novel corroborated type/call fact and a measurably improved source-level compiler hypothesis; else NO_ADDED_VALUE.

pilot_tasks.title: ROI decision and executor handoff
procedure: Compile actual admission, control and target evidence statuses.
Record native analyses actually executed versus proposed.
Adopt REA only on all positive gates; otherwise pin fallback to direct Ghidra or existing m2c/IDO tools.
If adopting, update affected G64 task packet with optional invocation and proof boundary.
pilot_tasks.acceptance: Explicit GO/NO_GO with reproducible limited scope, no false function promotions, all G64 core tasks executable without REA.

stop_conditions: Do not run ten controls after official refusal
Never count REA pseudocode as native instruction match
